name: Upload progress announcer
purpose: Owns the announcement side of the file-upload contract: the polite live-region wrapper the transport ticks, the aggregate-percent calculator, the assertive-slot completion announcement, and the background-tab tick continuity. Every AC on REQ-002 and REQ-005 that reads the aria-live regions anchors on this TAC.
responsibilities: Mount the polite live-region wrapper at render time so a screen reader adopts it before the first tick (AC-23102-1).
Emit a polite text tick every 10 percent of aggregate progress in the closed format "<uploaded> of <total> files, <PP> percent" (AC-23102-1).
Compute the aggregate percent as the mean weighted by byte size across the active file set (AC-23102-1).
On completion of the set, mount an assertive-slot announcement (aria-live="assertive" or role="status") with the closed text "<N> files uploaded successfully", exactly once per set (AC-23105-1).
Continue ticking under document visibilitychange to hidden so a backgrounded tab does not stall the announcement (AC-23107-1).
internalStructure: One announcer module the transport hooks. The module preseeds the polite wrapper (aria-live polite) on mount, reads per-chunk acknowledgements from the transport, updates a per-file percent + aggregate percent record, and pushes a text tick every time the floor(aggregate/10) integer changes. Completion detection is a single flag; the assertive slot is mounted on mount as an empty wrapper and its textContent is set exactly once per set. Background-tab continuity is achieved by using setInterval on the ack polling loop rather than requestAnimationFrame; the interval keeps firing when the tab is hidden. A project that wants to pause on hidden explicitly elicits the alternative.

interfaces.name: tick
interfaces.description: tick({ fileRowId, bytesAcknowledged, totalBytes }) -> void. Transport calls this on every acknowledgement.

interfaces.name: complete
interfaces.description: complete({ successCount }) -> void. Transport calls this exactly once per set.

interfaces.name: announcementFormatsEnum
interfaces.description: The polite format is fixed: /^\d+ of \d+ files, \d{1,3} percent$/; the assertive format is fixed: /^\d+ files uploaded successfully$/. Localisation is a v1.1.0 minor bump extending the enum with a lookup table.

dependencies.name: Transport contract
dependencies.description: The announcer reads per-chunk acknowledgements from the transport.

tradeoffs: One announcer module keeps the aria-live discipline testable but pins the wire format in English at v1.0.0; a localised project elicits the format table in a v1.1.0 minor. Known mechanism-reach gap: the pack asserts the polite wrapper's textContent format but does not additionally probe screen-reader adoption (that requires a real assistive tech in the loop).
notes: See README Known mechanism-reach gaps for the full list.
